headline: Cantonment OC withdrawn after viral audio clip criticising police, govt surfaces
summary: Md Rakibul Hasan, OC of Cantonment Police Station, has been attached to DMP headquarters following an audio clip where he allegedly made controversial remarks about the government, administration, and police force.
details: Md Rakibul Hasan, the officer-in-charge of Cantonment Police Station, has been withdrawn from his post and attached to the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) headquarters. This action follows the virality of an audio clip on social media, purportedly containing his controversial remarks.

The audio clip, which gained traction on Wednesday night, allegedly features Rakibul criticising the police force's perceived weakness and stating, "Sheikh Hasina is coming in December. Nothing will happen. You cannot even imagine how weak the police on the streets are."

He is also reportedly heard expressing frustration over senior officers, claiming some are aligned with the BNP. Rakibul allegedly stated, "Senior officers are aligned with the BNP, we are not... We did not join the department to do this."

Further allegations in the clip include criticism of senior officers' lavish lifestyles while field-level officers work hard. He also purportedly questioned the integrity of OC postings, suggesting, "The IGP’s driver is posting OCs... If you give him money...."

DMP Commissioner Mosleh Uddin Ahmed confirmed that a committee has been formed to investigate the incident involving Rakibul. He denied any scope for postings in exchange for money and stated that OCs are posted with his signature, not the IGP's.

The Commissioner also stated he was unaware of any senior police officers' affiliation with the BNP. Attempts to contact Rakibul, IGP Ali Hossain Fakir, and Police Headquarters AIG (media) Shahadat Hossain for comments were unsuccessful.

topic: woman jailed in jhenaidah over false rape attempt case
headline_marked: [[Woman jailed for false rape attempt case]] against businessman in Jhenaidah
headline: Woman jailed for false rape attempt case against businessman in Jhenaidah
summary: A woman in Jhenaidah has been sent to jail after a court dismissed her false accusation of attempted rape against a businessman. The court issued an arrest warrant against her for filing the fabricated case, which stemmed from a land dispute.
details: Beauty Khatun, 45, has been sent to jail in Jhenaidah for filing a false case of attempted rape against a local businessman. The Jhenaidah Women and Child Repression Prevention Tribunal dismissed her complaint after it was not proven in court.
Police arrested Beauty Khatun on Thursday, September 17, based on a court warrant. She was subsequently produced before the court and ordered to be sent to prison.

The false accusation originated from a long-standing land dispute between Beauty Khatun and businessman Miraj Zaman Raj over a piece of land in Char Muraridah village, Jhenaidah. Beauty filed her case under Section 9(b) of the Women and Child Repression Prevention Act.

In response, businessman Miraj Zaman Raj filed a counter-petition under the same act. The court took this into consideration and issued an arrest warrant against Beauty Khatun under Section 17 of the Women and Child Repression Prevention Act for filing a false case.

Md. Asaduzzaman, Officer-in-Charge (OC) of Jhenaidah Sadar Police Station, confirmed the arrest. He stated that Beauty Khatun was apprehended following the court's warrant and later remanded to jail by court order.
